title: Piplup — Bubble Maestro
description: A proud Piplup conducts its first Bubble attack from a sculpted snow floe. Three translucent bubbles rise beside its lifted flipper, curling surf frames its golden webbed feet, and a fish swims beneath a clear viewing patch in the tide.

sections.name: Connected gallery plinth and tidal pool
Golden webbed feet and round little body
One flipper conducts; the other balances
White face lobes, bright eyes and smiling bill
